text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: median of the intervals. Line: 25th to 75th percentile. Reduction in squared error on held-out days when a daily shape (demand term and solar term) replaces a constant offset; the dashed line is no gain. Blue: known answers. Orange: recorded intervals.'
text.tspan: Dot: median of the intervals. Line: 25th to 75th percentile. Reduction in
squared error on held-out days when a daily shape (demand term and solar term)
replaces a constant offset; the dashed line is no gain. Blue: known answers.
